## Problem and result

Describe the trigger, before/after behavior and scope. For governance-only work, say that no app behavior changes.

## Validation

- Commands and actual results:
- GUI checks, tested artifact and remaining gaps (or why not applicable):
- Native session/account/host, drafts, queues and Stop/restart impact (or not affected):

## Release record

- [ ] Product changes recorded in `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased, or this is internal work explained above.
- [ ] Public evidence contains no private conversations, account files, raw screenshots or local logs.
- [ ] Version/package/verification links remain consistent; release candidates also include launch, upgrade and rollback instructions.
- [ ] Required CI is green on the current PR revision before merge.

Fork policy: [docs/release-policy.md](../docs/release-policy.md).
